evidence: Touches `src/netbase.cpp` handling proxy connections and SOCKS5 destination address formatting for Tor outbound peer connectivity.
rationale: Fixes outbound connection failures over Tor SOCKS5 proxies to IPv6 peers with compressed addresses. As measured by the author, roughly 20% of addrman IPv6 addresses and 29% of DNS seed answers have an inner `::`, which previously caused Tor exit nodes to drop connections with general failure errors.
